notes.title: HOTFIX!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/cba9da36171a4aca87c01d5e8659b6db9a3c2880.png

Hi again everyone!

We released a hotfix just last night at around 1AM PST on Oct. 19th, 2017.
As I promised, here are the detailed info on what changed in this new version.

------------------

≪HOTFIX≫

The following issues have been addressed and fixed.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/5e3976afff83a44974794eb2bc05cd967ab38b90.png

------------------

１．Known issues and fixed bugs 

We’ve noticed similar bugs were being reported upon launch of GOKEN.
This hotfix should resolve these reported issues. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/168142c2afbe860f87d338fdb3810862a3942e55.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f900d89917f829887f2333f601e3203c22955d1e.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/650bddae800557e88bbb9be01d08f39eaaae78bc.png

≪Other Fixed Bugs≫
　・ Adjusted and fixed map data
　・ Fixed a bug where players were unable to use the Inn at Burning Lands
　・ Some Japanese texts appeared bugged
　・ Fixed a bug where some monsters wouldn’t move in certain areas
　・ Fixed a bug where unintended tracks would play
　・ Fixed a bug where the hidden boss would not move under certain conditions
　・Patched an event where players could access certain parts of maps when they aren’t supposed to
　・ Added the correct icon support for Xbox controllers

------------------

２．Performance Improvements

　Fixed stuttering issues and greatly improved loading time. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/ffb622bcfd87b15e6a1eb98c1614ce2085f195fc.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/2fceb10825031365cd7eb43472237776e5f86a69.png

------------------

３．Fixed and added dialogues to main story

　We’ve improved and added more dialogues to help players enjoy GOKEN more.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/cc94a40f77b2b5e90abea3440e6018f8c0d7a8e1.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31c5fabe364c7ac4cab07922b2a73198d2d69e05.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/48a9937ac3e4e5a236cdb4d15299da123923dd42.png

≪Other Improvements in Stories≫
　・ Fixed various texts for NPCs
　・ Fixed some texts in cut scenes
　・ Fixed some character motions during events
　・ Fixed some effects played during events

------------------

４．Improved usability of Daggers

We improved the usability of the only ranged weapon in GOKEN, the Daggers.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f61fe5bf09bc20ec73fe72ba47f7aac3513b35e1.png

------------------

５．Added and reevaluated prizes at Colosseum

　Adjusted the rates and added prizes to the Colosseum for players to enjoy

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/e3e73f3b580babe2fb1640642c9521dd01943dbb.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/4a8554c6291b57cfe48deb243356e622ab589ffc.png

≪Other Adjustments≫
　・ Changed the order of appearance for materials at the Colosseum

------------------

6．Adjusted pricing of Nimbus Cotton

　The Nimbus Cotton is now cheaper! Yay!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f09f434f0f0d8d2c803bd2f00e97223c2a50542b.png

------------------

7．Other Minor Adjustments

　[System Related Changes]
　　・ Fixed the clunky cursor movements in the name input section
　[Tutorial Related Changes]
　　・ Added “Tat Wiz” to tutorial
　　・ Fixed some texts in the tutorial
　　・ Changed some of the captures in the tutorial screen
　[Map related changes]
　　・ Moved around some locations of destructible objects 
　　・ Changed the texts on many signs
　　・ Changed the effects when jumping maps at the Phantom Tower
　　・ Added Auto Save points to each floors of the Phantom Tower
　　・ Changed the Map Jump location for the Colosseum floor of the Phantom Tower
　　・Changed how the Map Jump indicator is shown on the Colosseum floor of the Phantom Tower
　[Item Related Changes]
　　・ Added more locations the Nimbus Cotton can access
　　・ Changed the order of locations the Nimbus Cotton can access
　[Monster Related Changes] 
　　・ Changed locations for some monsters
　　・ Added a new type of monster
　　・ Made slight adjustments to some monster attack animations
[Weapon Related Changes]
　　・ Adjusted motion of the third strike for the “Blade”

------------------

8．The “other” controller issue
　Some Xbox One and Xinput controllers not working properly 
This problem is occurring to a small portion of our users.  We’re still trying to figure out what is causing this issue but players who are using, or have used any third-party “key mappers” in the past seem to be encountering issues with their said controllers.
Steam natively supports both Xbox One and most USB Xinput devices and these third-party apps may be interfering with our input system.
If this case does apply to you, we would like to ask that you turn off (and/or remove) any third-party mappers until we find a workaround for this bug. 
Additionally, please try accessing the controller settings through Steam to see if your controllers are being recognized properly.

------------------

That’s it for this Hotfix!
Some features we’ve planned on adding have been added but we mostly focused on incorporating what you, the users, asked for us!
In other words, if it weren’t for your voices, none of this could have been put together.
We’re so happy to hear from all of you all the time, and are really grateful for all your support!

We’ll continue to do our best in trying to keep providing the best experience GOKEN can offer to old-school gamers out there!
-Best Regards from the GOKEN Team-

notes.title: [Official Release!] GOKEN out of Early Access
notes.notes:
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DefensiveSpecificCougar-size_restricted.gif

It's finally here people!

Since GOKEN's Early Access release back in July, it's hard to believe that it has already been two full months...

With great help from the community and insights from extremely helpful reviewers, GOKEN has reached a stage where we feel comfortable saying that it is now a full retail product!

Allow us to "re-introduce" you to GOKEN.


-Scenario-
Long ago, when gods lived amongst people...

There lived a swordsman who was given five swords forged by god himself.

Using these swords, the swordsman brought peace and order to the world. 

People called the swordsman, "Wielder of the Five Swords"...

One day, during a fete to praise the gods, the blades of the swordsman turn against the gods for reasons unknown.

One of the gods, Ozone, furious with all his powers, sealed the swordsman away at the top of a mountain now known as Swords Peak.

This tale begins 5,000 years after the battle between the two, near the small village of Cardina.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/8c963afecdbdb8b565263f223166c6db3a50a2e4.jpg

-Game Overview-
Seamless open-world game mechanics
While the game features a rather old school “quarter view” mechanic, the map transitions and event scenes, even the combat is all seamless as can be to enhance the overall gaming experience.

Real time strategic action battle system
Utilizing 2 primary attack buttons, users can assign different weapons to each button to create a unique combo that fits the users need as they go. Monsters, bosses and stage gimmicks can require a specific type of weapon at times creating opportunities for users to strategize their best route of approach.

Customizable Tattoo system
Utilizing "tattoos", users are given specific points upon leveling to get the protagonist inked as a form of powering up so it could be built to one’s own. Raising MAX HP and Stamina, learning new and special moves are just a few of many ways players are able to customize their character depending on their play style.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/05e80b83848235c2a0ed34cfbefd57eaa4e34c83.jpg

Improvements made during Early Access
-Completely re-tuned the stamina system.
-Added ability to "sprint/"
-Adjusted weapon balance for each weapon to stand out more.
-Added support for Linux / Steam OS/ (yay!)
-Added extra scenarios for users to play.
-Added additional bosses to fight in case the game wasn't difficult enough >:D
-Added Side Quests for more game play.
-Added an "Endless Colosseum" mode for even MORE game play.
-New and improved Tattoo System 2.0 for character customization.
-Wiz Point system for even MORE character customization.
-Performance enhancements to rid those pesky stutters.
-Fixed many bugs and spelling errors.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/b26b6b42f797032b2a13320c56e0cc1dd2319c22.jpg

Finally...!
In celebration of GOKEN's official release, 

We are putting GOKEN on a 25% off sale for a limited time!
(Offer expires on Oct. 9th at 19:00 PM PST)

So if you were one of those people who waited for GOKEN to get released and actually caught us upon release, this is your chance to grab a copy!

Let us hear your voices in the forums, and as always, thank you for all your support!

notes.title: HOTFIX Released!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/756b0a99759303680cd41192a366bc0ea36da52d.png

Thanks for the wait guys!

We just released a new patch for GOKEN!

This hotfix includes the following.

-New Locations for Nimbus Cotton
We added more locations to where players can access with the Nimbus Cotton.  Now players can land right in front of visited dungeons.

-Improved Balance in Combat
Made various adjustments for weapons in combat.  Some weapons should feel a lot stronger than how they previously did. Find out which one in-game! 

-Improved Game Performance
The system has been revamped to greatly improve performance compared to previous versions of GOKEN.  Many of the stuttering issues should be fixed with this update if the previous one hadn't!

-Renewed Tattoo System
The Tattoo system has been renewed both graphically and systematically.  The screen should make more sense now and customizability has been greatly increased.

WARNING
The update to the tattoo system required us to reset all ink points.  All skills unlocked at the parlor have been reset after this update.  (All ink points have been returned to players.)

Other Bug Fixes
Many small bugs have also been fixed, both that have been reported and not.


Let us know what you think about this update and tell us what you would like more!

notes.title: Update Ver1.3.0 Released!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/703f1ec8113820751334fec5b9e3da4340a138c6.png

GOKEN Update Ver. 1,3,0 has just been released!

https://youtu.be/G5SuHUqh7RY

Here's what's in the update...

New Features

Colosseum Mode
This feature is specifically for those who have reclaimed all five of their swords and either are struggling to gather materials, or simply hungry for more...!
In the new Colosseum Mode, players will fight to their death facing endless waves of enemies.
Each wave is recorded and players will earn "Colosseum Points" to trade with materials.
Foes will get stronger as waves progress and there will be no limits to their powers...!

Additional Side Quests
More Side-quests will be added, mostly for new players.


**WARNING**
After this update, the blacksmith will be unaccessible until a side-quest at "Goodshores" is complete.


Bug Fixes
-Fixed some compatibility issues between certain controller models and operating systems. 
-Fixed input methods across various UI screens.
-Stuttering issues caused by certain scripts have been fixed (this fix should greatly improve performance but we are aware of other issues that may be causing the stutter.  It's still a work-in-progress but a fix nonetheless...!)
-Other various bugs to improve performance.

We also posted a new video regarding the update on the store page so make sure to check it out!

Let us know what you think about the update and enjoy GOKEN!

notes.title: Update ver 1.2.0 Details - part 2
notes.notes:
GOKEN now supports Steam Cloud!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31d558e31538501420daafabe719bd391fea8e21.jpg

  With this new additional feature, GOKEN can now be played everywhere right where you left off!  Your data would be synced and stored on Steam Cloud. 

  Here are the instructions to enable Steam Cloud:

1. Right click on "GOKEN" in your Steam LIBRARY. Then choose "Properties"

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/02980a70c32d6b9f66bc29282b2e172c3417c46e.jpg

2. In the "UPDATES" Tab, make sure you ticked the checkbox that says "Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for GOKEN". Then Close

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/9e625f098f8f657e56b3ad352e72d7150d752556.jpg

notes.title: Large Update Ver. 1.2.0 Released!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31d558e31538501420daafabe719bd391fea8e21.jpg

GOKEN takes another big step towards its full release with our 1.2.0 update released!

https://thumbs.gfycat.com/GracefulAcademicGrasshopper-size_restricted.gif

Here's what we have to offer...

-Wiz Points
A new customization option "Wiz Points" is added to further enable players to customize their hero to their liking.  
Find the Tat Wiz somewhere in the world to receive "Wiz Points."  The cooler your tattoo is, the more points you will receive!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f0c93811ee8bb994fa73c979f62557eca5ecefb2.png

-Quests
Aside from the main story, we have now added "Quests" to be played on the side with an all new interface supporting the system.
Complete these quests to receive items that will aid your journey and looting!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/543e789693223588f90f9c7e5ef5170a32581a91.png

-Additional Story
A few extra episodes have been added to the main story!
These stories contain some new dungeons and very powerful bosses, even for those who have already beaten the game are sure to be challenged... BE AWARE.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/35cf761bfebc9f9bae7eba8e13de246b17cbb0ea.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/88ad2c1510157a0bda8a394189d07200c32131b8.png

-Cloud Saving
Cloud saving is added for those who plan on playing GOKEN cross platforms.
Make sure to "save" in-game prior to using this feature as the save file itself needs to be updated.

We are, unfortunately, experiencing trouble transfering save datas to and from Steam OS.
i.e.
Steam OS to Windows OS 
 (Steam OS to Steam OS works flawlessly.)

We are working on a fix but in the mean time, please do not attempt transfering your save from Steam OS to another operating system.


-Game Balance
The enemies have been almost entirely revamped to better fit the new environment.  
Due to the players extreme buff by the new Wiz Point system, the game should feel a lot more challenging.


-Others
Some minor bugs have been tweaked out.


This update contains many new content and systems, so much and so, that players who have already beat the game are sure in for a surprise! (and a challenge of course!)  

I'd like to use this opportunity to thank everyone again for their continued support and hope you enjoy this new chapter of GOKEN!

notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/9c907e70d08a64c9bde8f4bdf04c19e9a49ff9a6.png

Hello everyone!

Thanks to all your reviews and requests, we're releasing the 1.1.0 update with the following features which should greatly improve the game experience!

Specifically, the following improvements have been made.

Major Improvements Towards Beginning
-Adjusted map for much less confusion
-Changed the texts on signs (and placed more of them)
-Added a camp in the Kinari Caves to restore player health
-Added a boss event before reaching the Kinari Caves
-Added multiple NPCs along the way to Cardina through the Kinari Caves


Gameplay Improvements
-By holding the Shift key / Circle button / B button, players can now sprint for long distance traveling
-Improved the recovery rate for stamina
-Adjusted balancing of weapons
-Adjusted damage in combat


Operating Systems
-Added Linux Support (Ubuntu 16.04.2 LTS 64 bit, SteamOS）


Others
-Fixed bugs (and spelling errors)

We here at GIANTY are still making further improvements to GOKEN and many of these are based from your feedback!

So please support us by keeping those feedbacks coming; let us know how we can make GOKEN your favorite ARPG ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Quick Patch Released!
notes.notes:
Hello guys.
It's come to our attention that we had a critical bug that prevented some users with outdated dll files from booting GOKEN.

These users would have experienced a hang just after the GIANTY splash logo upon booting the game. 

Seeing this as a rather critical issue, we decided to release a patch to fix specifically this error.

We apologize for any inconvenience we have caused until now.

Stay tuned for future updates and keep your voices coming!


パッチリリースの報告となります。

先日より、GOKENの起動時、GIANTYのロゴ表示後ゲームがフリーズするバグが発覚しました。
「ゲームが起動できない」という緊急性の高いバグであったため、こちらのみ早急に対処させていただき、このたびパッチとしてリリースさせていただくことになりました。

ご不便をおかけした皆様、大変申し訳ございませんでした。

引き続き皆様のご支援、お声を頂き、GOKEN改善に努めてまいりますので、よろしくお願いいたします。
